design: Frozen H1001nounrank1. Cross background knife/key with food/access actions, four subjects, four verb pairs. Action swaps hold background fixed; background swaps hold action fixed. Additional new tool/action pairs are explicitly coupled. No fitting or outcome-selected prompts.
gate: For each action cohort/condition:4pairs, >=.75both intended endpoints category-correct and >=.5full-vocab top1. No correctness filtering. Nuisance pairs have same intended category at both endpoints.
limits: Background nouns may legitimately prime continuations. Category lists imperfect; food versus access is not a universal semantic taxonomy. New-tool pairs covary tool and action. Original subjects reused, prompts new. No claim of complete factorial orthogonalization of meaning.
controls: Identity, full donor, nounrank1, task128, task128+nounrank1, paired +/- residual noise norm matched to nounrank1 edit. No original holdouts.
